//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the LOADER component (animated loaders). See ../README.md and button.json for the model. SCOPE: this covers the advanced-loader family only — the `loader/1` (keen) / <Loader> (svelte) wrappers, i.e. `pa-loader-{type}` where type ∈ dots|bars|pulse|ring|wave. The rotating `pa-spinner` is a SEPARATE component (keen `spinner/1`, svelte <Spinner>) and is NOT in scope here. Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/loaders.html + _loaders.scss.

propsVocabulary.type: loader animation type: dots|bars|pulse|ring|wave — selects the block class pa-loader-{type} AND the child-span shape (dots=3 spans, bars/wave=5 spans, pulse/ring=no children)
propsVocabulary.size: lg — the only size modifier; emits the type-coupled class pa-loader-{type}--lg
propsVocabulary.color: primary|secondary|success|danger|warning|info — loaders paint from currentColor, so colour is set on the wrapper (see colorConvention), NOT via a pa-loader-{type}--{color} modifier (none exist in core)
propsVocabulary.class: extra classes appended verbatim (passthrough, not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Structural: the block class is pa-loader-{type}; dots emits exactly 3 empty <span> children, bars/wave emit exactly 5, pulse/ring emit none (CSS-only — pulse via background, ring via ::after). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.
colorConvention: Core blesses NO pa-loader-{type}--{color} class — loaders theme via `currentColor`, set on the wrapper. The core snippet (snippets/loaders.html) documents this as an inline `style="color: var(--…)"`. Both wrappers therefore set colour off-class: keen via inline `style="color: var(--pc-accent | --pc-text-color-2 | --pa-{color}-bg)"`, svelte likewise (aligned in this slice — previously svelte emitted a `text-{color}` utility class, a divergent shape). The colour→variable map: primary→--pc-accent, secondary→--pc-text-color-2, success/danger/warning/info→--pa-{color}-bg (there is no --pa-primary-bg/--pa-secondary-bg, hence the two special cases). Colour scenarios below assert the inline-style form.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. NOTE on blocks: there is no `pa-loader` base class nor `pa-loader--*` modifier — each type is its own block `pa-loader-{type}`, so this fixture uses the multi-block form `blocks: [pa-loader-dots … pa-loader-wave]`. Axis-1's reverse check then verifies each family block's only modifier, the type-coupled `pa-loader-{type}--lg` (claimed via cssStateClasses below). `size` is type-coupled (pa-loader-{type}--{size}) which the single-template expander can't express, so its produces is null and it is verified through scenarios + goldens. `color` produces null (off-class, currentColor — see colorConvention).

size.note: type-coupled — emits pa-loader-{type}--lg (e.g. pa-loader-dots--lg). Verified via scenarios/goldens since the produces template can't carry both {type} and {size}.

color.note: off-class — set on the wrapper as inline currentColor (see colorConvention), never a pa-loader modifier.

class.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: The per-type --lg modifiers (pa-loader-dots--lg … pa-loader-wave--lg) are the `size` feature's type-coupled output (see its note). With the multi-block `blocks` list, axis-1's reverse check DOES see them (one --lg per family block); listing them here claims them so the reverse check passes.

scenarios.name: color-secondary
scenarios.note: secondary → --pc-text-color-2 (there is no --pa-secondary-bg). svelte previously dropped 'secondary' entirely; aligned in this slice.
